_note: SAMPLE reviews and questions for the clickable prototype, shown with a 'sample' label. Never ship these as real reviews. ageBand is one of 0-3, 3-6, 6-12, 12-36 (months); skin is normal, dry, sensitive or eczema.

reviews.title: No redness after bath, finally.
reviews.body: Tried three before this one. Her cheeks used to go pink after every bath. Two weeks in, no redness.

reviews.title: Gentle, but the pump sticks.
reviews.body: Works well on his skin. The pump stopped coming back up after a few weeks.
reviews.reply: Thank you for telling us. We've changed the pump supplier for the next batch and sent you a replacement.

reviews.title: Our paediatrician suggested something mild.
reviews.body: Switched after the doctor said to avoid anything heavily scented. Spreads easily, no stickiness.

reviews.title: Light enough for Chennai.
reviews.body: Doesn't feel heavy in the humidity. I use a little more when the AC is on.

questions.q: Can I use this on a 2-week-old?
questions.a: Yes, it's made for use from birth. In the first weeks, a little goes a long way.

questions.q: Is it too heavy for Chennai summers?
questions.a: It's light. I use less in May and more when the AC is on.

reviews.title: Absorbs well, not sticky.
reviews.body: Good for the daily maalish. I'd like a pump on the bottle.

reviews.title: Nani approves.
reviews.body: My mother-in-law has strong views on massage oil. She likes this one. It smells only of coconut.

questions.q: Is this safe if there's a nut allergy in the family?
questions.a: It contains sweet almond oil, so please don't use it if your baby has a nut allergy, and check with your paediatrician if there's a family history.

reviews.title: Dry patches gone in a week.
reviews.body: Delhi winters are rough on her elbows and cheeks. A little twice a day has made a real difference.

reviews.title: Thick, takes a moment to rub in.
reviews.body: Works on his dry knees. Warm it in your fingers first and it spreads better.

reviews.title: Redness better by morning.
reviews.body: Put a thin layer on at the night change. By morning the redness had mostly settled.

reviews.title: Wipes off easily.
reviews.body: Some zinc creams are like paint. This one comes off with a water wipe.

questions.q: Can I use it at every change?
questions.a: Yes. Clean and dry the nappy area, then apply a thin layer at every change. If a rash blisters, oozes or comes with a fever, please see your doctor.

reviews.title: Lives in the changing bag.
reviews.body: Chapped cheeks, dry lips, my own cuticles. The tin is tiny and goes everywhere.

reviews.title: Faint ghee smell, works well.
reviews.body: Smells a little like home. Melts nicely on the fingertip.

reviews.title: Slight white cast, fades in a minute.
reviews.body: Expected it to be chalky, but it settles quickly. We reapply after the park.

reviews.title: Good for our holiday.
reviews.body: Used it every two hours on the beach. No redness on his shoulders.

questions.q: Can I use this on my 4-month-old?
questions.a: It's for babies 6 months and older. Before 6 months, please keep your baby out of direct sun instead of using sunscreen.

reviews.title: Keeps neck folds dry in summer.
reviews.body: A little in my palm, then onto the folds. Helps in the Mumbai humidity.

reviews.title: Glad it's talc-free.
reviews.body: I was avoiding powder entirely until I found a corn starch one. The shaker doesn't puff out too much.

reviews.title: No milky smell left.
reviews.body: Bottles and pump parts come out clean and don't smell of soap either.

reviews.title: The foam goes a long way.
reviews.body: One pump does a bottle and teat. Lasting about five weeks for us.

reviews.title: Gentle on her face.
reviews.body: We use these for her face and hands too, not just changes. No redness.

reviews.title: Good wipes, lid could close better.
reviews.body: The wipes are great. The lid doesn't always snap shut, so the last few dry out.
reviews.reply: Thank you. We're testing a firmer hinge for the next batch. Pressing the centre of the lid until it clicks helps for now.

reviews.title: One bottle for everything.
reviews.body: Hair and body in one, which matters when you're holding a slippery baby.

reviews.title: Mild lather, rinses fast.
reviews.body: Doesn't foam a lot, which I like. Her skin doesn't feel tight after.

reviews.title: Tangles are gone.
reviews.body: Her curls used to knot after every wash. Much easier to comb now.

reviews.title: Bath time without crying.
reviews.body: Some got near his eyes and he didn't fuss. We still keep the water away from his face.

reviews.title: Bath time is easy now.
reviews.body: He runs to the bathroom when he hears the tap. One capful is plenty.

reviews.title: Bubbles last the whole bath.
reviews.body: We keep baths short anyway. No dryness afterwards.

reviews.title: The mango won him over.
reviews.body: He used to clamp his mouth shut. Now he opens wide for the mango one.

reviews.title: A tube lasts ages.
reviews.body: With a rice-grain amount twice a day, we're barely a third through.

reviews.title: Soft on sore gums.
reviews.body: Teething week was rough. Rubbing her gums with this calmed her down.

reviews.title: The case is handy.
reviews.body: Goes in the travel bag without getting fluff on it.

reviews.title: The magnifier on the clipper is a lifesaver.
reviews.body: I was terrified of trimming newborn nails. Doing it after the bath with this helped.

reviews.title: Nice pouch, soft brush.
reviews.body: Comb and brush are gentle. The pouch washes well.

reviews.title: The cord cut-out actually works.
reviews.body: Nothing rubbing on the stump in the first week. The fawn print is sweet too.

reviews.title: Wetness line helps at night.
reviews.body: I can check without opening the diaper. We're close to outgrowing the newborn size.

questions.q: What do I use after 5 kg?
questions.a: Right now Nanhe makes Newborn (up to 5 kg) and Medium pants (7–12 kg). A size for 5–7 kg is [to be confirmed].

reviews.title: No leaks overnight.
reviews.body: Twelve hours really does mean twelve hours for us.

reviews.title: Easy with a wriggly crawler.
reviews.body: No more chasing her with tapes. Tearing the sides to take them off is so much quicker.

reviews.title: Thick enough for dal hands.
reviews.body: One wipe handles a whole lunch. Smells lightly of cucumber.

reviews.title: Good for the car.
reviews.body: Lives in the glovebox for sticky moments.

reviews.title: Better value, same wipes.
reviews.body: We go through a pack every few days, so the three-pack makes sense.

reviews.title: Unopened packs stay fresh.
reviews.body: Kept two in the cupboard for a month, still moist when we opened them.
